mostWorthwhile.text: Following fragments from a destructive collision into the growing rocky world was most worthwhile: it connected a setback to another body's growth.

leastWorthwhile.text: The icy-body formation felt least distinctive because it repeated the rocky swarm's concentration and collapse.

surprise.text: The rocky pebble swarm became a population of separate bodies through gravitational collapse, rather than simply sticking into one object.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly purposeless, although the compatible-options menu guided the combinations rather than requiring me to discover them.

continue.text: I'd probably continue to see how the large icy body's mass affects its encounter with disk gas, though the parallel formation paths became somewhat repetitive.
